sentences.en: Hey, Josh and Craig.
sentences.zh: 嘿，乔什和克雷格。

sentences.en: My name is Heather.
sentences.zh: 我叫希瑟。

sentences.en: I am from Clearfield, Utah.
sentences.zh: 我来自犹他州克利尔菲尔德。

sentences.en: What does How About Your Mother mean to me?
sentences.zh: “如何遇见你母亲”对我意味着什么？

sentences.en: I absolutely love the show.
sentences.zh: 我真的超级喜欢这部剧。

sentences.en: I've watched every season several times,
sentences.zh: 每一季我都看了好几遍，

sentences.en: but I'm actually sending this voice note to you guys
sentences.zh: 但其实我是给你们发这条语音留言的，

sentences.en: because I just listened to the episode that you did
sentences.zh: 因为我刚刚听了你们做的那期节目，

sentences.en: about how you guys spent your summers between seasons two and three.
sentences.zh: 关于你们在第二季和第三季之间是怎么过夏天的。

sentences.en: And I know what you went through, Craig, with your son.
sentences.zh: 克雷格，我懂你经历过什么，为了你的儿子。

sentences.en: I had my son actually 14 weeks early.
sentences.zh: 我的儿子其实早产了14周。

sentences.en: He spent five months in the hospital.
sentences.zh: 他在医院待了五个月。

sentences.en: He was weighing one pound, ten ounces when he was born.
sentences.zh: 他出生时只有一磅十盎司重。

sentences.en: There was plenty of times where we did not know if my son was going to make it home.
sentences.zh: 有很多次，我们都不知道我的儿子能不能活着回家。

sentences.en: And listening to that episode, it makes me realize that there's other people out there that don't.
sentences.zh: 听了那一集，让我意识到还有其他人……

sentences.en: Sorry, that go through this kind of stuff that me and Craig have gone through.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，是经历过我和克雷格经历过的这种事情的人。

sentences.en: And I appreciate you for being vulnerable in that podcast episode, Craig.
sentences.zh: 克雷格，我很感激你在那期播客里展现出脆弱的一面。

sentences.en: I know this is supposed to be 60 seconds.
sentences.zh: 我知道这节目本来应该是60秒。

sentences.en: I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 对不起。

sentences.en: I'm going over.
sentences.zh: 我超时了。

sentences.en: I just want to let you guys know that now my son is 13 years old.
sentences.zh: 我只是想让你们知道，现在我儿子13岁了。

sentences.en: He has become completely obsessed with Marilyn Monroe.
sentences.zh: 他变得对玛丽莲·梦露着迷得不得了。

sentences.en: He says he's going to marry her one day.
sentences.zh: 他说他有一天要娶她。

sentences.en: Fingers crossed.
sentences.zh: 祝他好运。

sentences.en: He can name all the presidents that we've ever had from George Washington to where we're at now.
sentences.zh: 他能说出我们历任的所有总统，从乔治·华盛顿到现在的每一位。

sentences.en: He is an amazing kid and I just wanted to thank you guys and let you know that this podcast really helps
sentences.zh: 他是个了不起的孩子，我只是想谢谢你们，让你们知道这个播客真的很有帮助，

sentences.en: and it really means a lot to a lot of people out there.
sentences.zh: 而且对外面许许多多的人来说意义重大。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你们。

sentences.en: Hello, welcome back to How We Made Your Mother.
sentences.zh: 哈喽，欢迎回到《我们是如何创造你母亲的》。

sentences.en: I'm Josh Radner.
sentences.zh: 我是乔什·拉德纳。

sentences.en: I'm here with Craig Thomas.
sentences.zh: 我和克雷格·托马斯在一起。

sentences.en: Hey, Josh.
sentences.zh: 嘿，乔什。

sentences.en: Craig co-created this show, How I Met Your Mother, that I was on for a long time.
sentences.zh: 克雷格共同创造了这部我演了很久的剧《老爸老妈浪漫史》。

sentences.en: And we've been doing this podcast for a while now.
sentences.zh: 而且我们做这个播客也有一段时间了。

sentences.en: And man, how are you feeling hearing that, Craig?
sentences.zh: 天哪，听到这个你有什么感觉，克雷格？

sentences.en: Just blown away.
sentences.zh: 简直震撼。

sentences.en: Just blown away.
sentences.zh: 简直震撼到不行。

sentences.en: I almost can't even talk about how much it means to me that you try to talk about the stuff you go through.
sentences.zh: 每当我想到你们去谈论自己经历的那些事，其意义对我来说重大到我几乎说不出话来。

sentences.en: We had these lives we were living while we were making this TV show and all this stuff is happening
sentences.zh: 我们在制作这部电视剧的同时也过着自己的生活，发生了这么多事，

sentences.en: and not all of it went on the TV show.
sentences.zh: 并不是所有事都放进了电视剧里。

sentences.en: Of course, it informed the TV show, but not all of it makes it on the TV show.
sentences.zh: 当然，它们给电视剧提供了灵感，但并非所有事都能进入电视剧。

sentences.en: So to have this opportunity with this podcast to talk about what was going on in our human lives
sentences.zh: 所以能通过这个播客有机会谈论我们在现实生活中的经历，

sentences.en: outside of the lives we're creating on TV,
sentences.zh: 就是在我们电视创作之外的生活，

sentences.en: you know, it's always vulnerable to share those very real things we've been through.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，分享那些我们经历过的非常真实的时刻总是需要勇气的。

sentences.en: But to know that it hit this, you know, that it speaks to people out there and we get a message like that,
sentences.zh: 但得知它触动了，你知道的，它能引起大家的共鸣，我们收到了这样的留言，

sentences.en: it's incredibly meaningful.
sentences.zh: 这真的意义非凡。

sentences.en: Thank you for that beautiful message.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你发来这么美好的留言。

sentences.en: I'm so happy to hear your son is 13 years old and doing amazing.
sentences.zh: 很高兴听说你的儿子已经13岁了，而且过得非常好。

sentences.en: And like what you've been through, not everybody in your life understands it.
sentences.zh: 而且就像你经历过的那样，你生活中的并不是每个人都能理解。

sentences.en: And there's no way they could.
sentences.zh: 他们也绝无可能理解。

sentences.en: You kind of don't know what that one's like unless you go through it.
sentences.zh: 如果你没有亲身经历过，你大概是不会明白那种感觉的。

sentences.en: And it feels very, very lonely.
sentences.zh: 而且那种感觉真的非常、非常孤独。

sentences.en: And I felt very lonely in that moment of my life.
sentences.zh: 我在人生的那一刻也感到非常孤独。

sentences.en: And making this TV show made me feel less lonely.
sentences.zh: 而制作这部电视剧让我感到不那么孤独了。

sentences.en: The idea that the show found you and then its podcast found you and that, you know,
sentences.zh: 这部剧找到了你，接着它的播客也找到了你，然后，你知道的，

sentences.en: that it speaks to people and finds people out there.
sentences.zh: 它能与人们产生共鸣，并找到外面的那些人。

sentences.en: I think things find people, right?
sentences.zh: 我觉得事物会找到属于它的人，对吧？

sentences.en: You put these things out there and you just believe in your heart it's going to find people.
sentences.zh: 你把这些东西创作出来，并且你内心坚信它会找到它的人。

sentences.en: So thank you for letting me know that that found you and sharing your story with us.
sentences.zh: 所以谢谢你让我知道它找到了你，并与我们分享你的故事。

sentences.en: I just can't tell you how much it means to me.
sentences.zh: 我简直无法形容这对我有多么重大意义。

sentences.en: Craig, I'm struck by just the simple act of being truthful and vulnerable,
sentences.zh: 克雷格，我感触最深的是保持真实和脆弱这个简单的举动，

sentences.en: like the consequential kind of downstream effects of that, which are so beautiful.
sentences.zh: 就像它随之带来的深远影响一样，那是如此美好。

sentences.en: And I heard this thing once that said,
sentences.zh: 我曾经听过这样一句话：

sentences.en: when we talk about our accomplishments, it breeds competition and sometimes envy.
sentences.zh: 当我们谈论自己的成就时，它会滋生竞争，有时还有嫉妒。

sentences.en: But when we are vulnerable, it breeds community.
sentences.zh: 但当我们展现脆弱时，它会滋生社群感。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: We find each other at our wounds, right?
sentences.zh: 我们在彼此的创伤处相遇，对吧？

sentences.en: At the places we're hurting.
sentences.zh: 在我们感到痛苦的地方。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: And I'm glad, I'm so glad we did that episode.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴，我非常高兴我们拍了那一集。

sentences.en: And I'm so glad that the podcast is meeting people where they,
sentences.zh: 我也非常高兴这个播客能在人们所处的地方与他们相遇，

sentences.en: just as How I Met Your Mother did.
sentences.zh: 就像《老爸老妈浪漫史》曾经做的那样。

sentences.en: I mean, there's a kind of, this is a cousin of the show.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这可以说是该剧的表亲。

sentences.en: You know, it's kind of a, it's a companion of the show.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这有点像是该剧的伴侣。

sentences.en: And I hope, my hope is that some of what people consider so magical and heartwarming and loneliness,
sentences.zh: 我希望，我的希望是人们所认为的那些神奇、暖心以及孤独感，

sentences.en: like the kind of antidote to loneliness that we talk about with How I Met Your Mother,
sentences.zh: 就像我们在《老爸老妈浪漫史》中讨论的那种对抗孤独的良药，

sentences.en: we hope that the podcast is carrying that frequency too.
sentences.zh: 我们希望这个播客也能传递这种频率。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And we're, of course, getting the benefit of that too.
sentences.zh: 而且我们当然也从中受益了。

sentences.en: Because now I feel even, you know, I feel less alone hearing that story.
sentences.zh: 因为现在我甚至，你知道的，听到这个故事让我觉得更不孤单了。

sentences.en: And it's just, it's very meaningful.
sentences.zh: 而且这真的，真的很有意义。

sentences.en: And I think we're all seeking community and connection right now so, so much.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们现在所有人都非常、非常渴望社群和连结。

sentences.en: We need it so desperately in 2026 for so very many reasons.
sentences.zh: 出于种种原因，我们在2026年极其迫切地需要它。

sentences.en: And that, to connect in this way is really great and really healing.
sentences.zh: 以这种方式建立连结真的很棒，而且真的能治愈人心。

sentences.en: So thank you.
sentences.zh: 所以谢谢你。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，那一集叫做《我们是如何度过夏天的》。

sentences.en: And you can, you can find it in our podcast feed.
sentences.zh: 你可以在我们的播客订阅源里找到它。

sentences.zh: 谢谢我们的制作人亚历克·莱夫。

sentences.en: Thanks, Alec.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，亚历克。

sentences.zh: 话说回来，你喜欢一上来就对我们进行情感折磨吗？

sentences.zh: 你是不是就喜欢给我们塞一些能把他们的心都撕裂的东西？

sentences.zh: 然后他们就不得不去谈论一集非常、非常、非常无厘头的电视剧。

sentences.en: And you're like, let's see how they pivot.
sentences.zh: 而你就在想：让我们看看他们怎么过渡。

sentences.en: How can they make the transition?
sentences.zh: 他们要怎么完成这个转变？

sentences.en: You're like an evil emotional puppet master over there.
sentences.zh: 你简直就像坐在那里的一个邪恶的情感木偶师。

sentences.en: Like, like, ah, they've walked right into my trap.
sentences.zh: 就像在说：啊，他们直接走进我的陷阱了。

sentences.en: Greatest, Alec.
sentences.zh: 太棒了，亚历克。

sentences.en: Thank you for that message.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你发来这条信息。

sentences.en: That was unbelievably beautiful.
sentences.zh: 这真的是美妙得难以置信。
